items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: This was Jester-Pillars, I was playing trumpet, Snub Mosley was playing trombone and Godley was playing drums.

ctx.x: Oh, was she from Cleveland? I didn't know that.

Cleveland, yeah. And then we started working a place that was just a hotel, called the Heat Wave Bar. This was Jester-Pillars, I was playing trumpet, Snub Mosley was playing trombone and Godley was playing drums. I forget who we had on bass. A guy playing tuba named Slim Waters. He could play tuba like you play trumpet. Oh, he used to jam with the trumpet players. He was from Jersey.

items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he went down. We stopped by Harry's mother--he's from Ohio anyway, and we stopped by and she was telling me to take care of her baby

ctx.x: Harry Edison was in the band?
Yeah, he went down. We stopped by Harry's mother--he's from Ohio anyway, and we stopped by and she was telling me to take care of her baby, and there I was, I wasn't much older than he.
